thread:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - canary error spike for model redwood/gpt-lms v5.* deployed to canary clusters in us-west-2. Error rate > 85% for generation requests. Paged: @sre-oncall-alex @jamal.patel

maria.choi: seeing a huge error ratio from canary. user-facing failures (garbled text) on gen requests.

maria.choi: sample error from prod-proxy logs: `HTTP 500 - tokenization_error` and `ValueError: unknown token id -1`

jamal.patel: on it. initial look: canary deployment used model alias `gpt-lms:latest` which pulled weightset tag `w-2026-03-12-rc` — but the tokenizer bundle on the image is v0.5 while the weights were generated with tokenizer v0.4. mismatch in tokenizer vocab shape.

jamal.patel: logs from model-worker: ```2026-03-12T10:12:05Z [error] KV cache mismatch: key dim 10240 != 1024
2026-03-12T10:12:06Z [error] Tokenizer vocab size 50265 vs expected 50257
2026-03-12T10:12:06Z [critical] raise ValueError('vocab mismatch')
```

sre-oncall-alex: taking lead. canary traffic 2% -> pause deploy. @devops-bot can you freeze the rollout and flip the feature flag?

devops-bot: Action requested: freeze-rollout gpt-lms canary -> SUCCESS
devops-bot: Action requested: set-flag use-gpt-lms-v5 OFF -> SUCCESS

jamal.patel: confirmed flag OFF, traffic dropped to 0. Canary instances still running but not serving. We should rollback weights to v5.1.9 which had matching tokenizer.

maria.choi: support reports a customer (AcmePayments) saw garbled PII in samples; they filed a ticket. Not widespread but SLO-sensitive. Notifying trust & safety.

ricardo.support: I already pinged AcmePayments, gave temporary workaround (use older model alias). They asked for ETA.

product-lina: status page patch? customers asking. Small impact but high severity for those customers.

jamal.patel: performing rollback: ```# CLI
redwoodctl model rollback --model gpt-lms --from canary --to-tag w-2026-02-28-stable --force-checksum true
```

jamal.patel: rollback started — currently draining canary pods after swap. watching error-rate panels.

incident-bot: Canary rollback initiated by jamal.patel at 2026-03-12T10:18:40Z. Notifying oncall channels.

sre-oncall-alex: confirm: we also need to revert the manifest that caused alias to point at `w-2026-03-12-rc`. I see the deploy job set alias via `deploy-api: promote-latest` step.

jamal.patel: yes, deploying a hotfix to the promotion job to add tokenizer checksum verification. Patch: add compare between model bundle meta.tokenizer_hash and tokenizer image hash. If mismatch, abort promotion.

maria.choi: quick verify: after rollback, canary error rate dropped to baseline (<=1.2%). logs show no more tokenization_error.

sre-oncall-alex: good. I'm keeping the canary paused. For mitigation we flipped feature flag, froze rollout, rolled back weights. Next steps: RACI and postmortem.

product-lina: customer communication drafted. We should offer affected customers a 10k credit and a follow-up call.

ricardo.support: noted. I'll attach request to ticket and escalate for priority response.

jamal.patel: preliminary root cause: automated promotion pipeline used `latest` tag that pointed to partially uploaded weightset. The weight upload finished but tokenizer artifact upload lagged; promotion didn't validate artifacts atomically. Also missing tokenizer hash check.

maria.choi: short-term changes: 1) add artifact atomicity check on release pipeline 2) require tokenizer/hash checksum equality 3) add canary smoke tests for tokenizer-vocab-size and basic decode/encode a small corpus.

sre-oncall-alex: operational actions: 1) leave canary paused until pipeline patch lands and a dry-run deploy passes 2) run a controlled re-promote to canary with explicit tag `w-2026-02-28-stable` 3) schedule on-call followups.

jamal.patel: I've opened github PR #2245 with the promotion-job checksum guard. Also created runbook note: `runbooks/rollback-tokenizer-mismatch` with steps to flip flag, run rollback CLI, and snapshot problem cluster.

incident-bot: Incident declared: INCIDENT-2026-03-CANARY-TOKENIZER-MISMATCH. Severity: P2 -> upgraded to P1 for targeted customer impact.

product-lina: assigning postmortem owner: @jamal.patel. Timeline needed, blameless writeup, customer timeline and remediation plan.

sre-oncall-alex: handing off to next oncall @sre-oncall-alex (staying on until followups) — if anything spikes, page me.

maria.choi: thanks everyone. quick retros: we need pre-promote checks for tokenizer/weights parity and a tiny downstream infer smoke test in the pipeline.

jamal.patel: follow-ups created: - PR 2245 (promotion guard) - Runbook added - Customer comms + credits queued

ricardo.support: will push the customer update after comp approval.

product-lina: closing loop: status page updated to show "mitigated, rollback completed, targeted customers contacted".

sre-oncall-alex: closing incident channel but keeping pinned logs and action items. Postmortem to be published within 3 business days. :thumbsup:
